title: Royal Caribbean Wants More of Your Vacation

source.author: Bailey Schulz
source.title: Royal Caribbean Says Sandals Deal Can Help It Win Half of Guests' Travel Spend
source.notes: Skift body is paywalled after the first paragraphs; the 20-25% / roughly 50% share of vacation spend, the 'close to half' repeat guests and the CEO quote come from Skift's readable body (company statements on the earnings call, not in the release). Revenue, net income, guests, demand, guidance, Sandals stake, resorts, acres, 30% overlap, closing date and 2027 bookings come from Royal Caribbean Group's press release of 2026-10-27 and match Skift's Key Points/Summary where both mention them. Onboard revenue +14% is from Skift's summary (citing Truist) and matches the release table (1,706 vs 1,502 $m). The $3 billion price appears only in Skift's summary, not the release: not used. Load factor, yields, Q4 EPS and analyst upgrades left out.

figures.quote: MIAMI, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Royal Caribbean Group (NYSE: RCL) today reported third quarter Earnings per Share

figures.text: Q3 revenue $5.6 billion, up 9% year over year
figures.quote: Total revenue was $5.6 billion, a 9% increase year over year.

figures.text: Q3 net income $1.7 billion vs $1.6 billion a year earlier
figures.quote: Net Income for the third quarter of 2026 was $1.7 billion or $6.45 per share compared to Net Income of $1.6 billion
delivered memorable vacations to 2.7 million guests, a 9% increase year over year.

figures.text: better than expected late (close-in) demand in Europe and the Caribbean
figures.quote: driven by better-than-expected close-in demand in Europe and the Caribbean.

figures.text: full-year adjusted EPS now $17.85 to $17.95 (guidance raised)
figures.quote: The company now expects full year Adjusted EPS to be in the range of $17.85 to $17.95.

figures.text: close to half of guests this year expected to be repeat customers
figures.quote: Close to half of guests this year are expected to be repeat customers

figures.text: company captures 20% to 25% of guests' annual vacation spend; expected to reach roughly 50%
figures.quote: said it captures 20% to 25% of its guests' annual vacation spend. By adding all-inclusive resorts to its ecosystem, that reach is expected to stretch to roughly 50%.

figures.text: in September agreed to buy a 50% stake in Sandals and Beaches Resorts
figures.quote: In September, Royal Caribbean Group announced an agreement to acquire a 50% interest in Sandals and Beaches Resorts

figures.text: 18 resorts in the Caribbean, three under development
figures.quote: The Sandals and Beaches Resorts' portfolio includes 18 resorts across the Caribbean and three resorts under development.

figures.text: over 1,000 acres of undeveloped land, room for growth
figures.quote: It also includes over 1,000 acres of undeveloped land in the Caribbean

figures.text: about 30% of Royal Caribbean guests also take all-inclusive vacations; similar share of Sandals guests cruise
figures.quote: Approximately 30% of Royal Caribbean Group guests also take all-inclusive vacations, while a similar percentage of Sandals and Beaches guests also cruise

figures.text: CEO Jason Liberty: a customer on a rival cruise brand is a fail; connected loyalty should keep customers
figures.quote: If a Royal Caribbean customer goes on a competitive cruise brand, I think that's a fail,” CEO Jason Liberty said

figures.text: deal expected to close in early 2027, subject to approvals
figures.quote: The investment is expected to close in early 2027, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.

figures.text: 2027 bookings pacing ahead of historical levels at higher rates
figures.quote: 2027 bookings are pacing ahead of historical levels at higher rates
